host: macOS headless discworld-ipad Host; no UIKit or simulator input
comparisons: Fresh host restores exact saved session bytes and framebuffer.
Truncated and oversized quick-save loads leave live session bytes unchanged.
Failed atomic publication leaves no temporary file and keeps live session unchanged.
After failed I/O, 240 successive frames, float PCM bit patterns and combined engine/DSP session bytes equal the freshly loaded baseline.
limitations: Fresh Host construction in the same process, not an OS process relaunch.
One bedroom checkpoint; not all acts or audio contexts.
Does not establish physical-device audio quality or UIKit gesture behavior.
